description.value: Wendy's is a major North American fast food chain offering square fresh-never-frozen beef burgers, chicken sandwiches, salads, and its signature Frosty dessert. This Chilliwack location has drive-through and takeout service, providing a reliable high-calorie stop for cyclists moving through the Fraser Valley corridor. As a large chain franchise, cyclist-specific amenities are not documented on the corporate website.
